Applies to both events (BUSINV, ISRATIO). Census MTIS release CB-99-154 (1999-08-13) states that the retail and wholesale estimates were revised based on results from the 1997 Census of Retail Trade and the 1997 Census of Wholesale Trade. annual_benchmark is the project's benchmark category; the source does not call this an ordinary annual benchmark. Limitations: the server file truncates lines at 140 characters, so the notice is incomplete as quoted; the notice states no revision start month, so no numeric check against the data was possible.

The BLS evidence (Bulletin 1039, June 29, 1951) supports methodology_change because it documents recalculation back to January 1950 using revised weights, new items and correction of rent bias, and the stated 1.3-point January 1950 difference matches the observed change (166.9 -> 168.2). The bulletin was published after this vintage and does not identify the first publication date of the adjusted series: this is retrospective government evidence supported by an exact numerical match, not a release notice contemporaneous with the vintage. Limitation: the quoted text is FRASER's OCR of the scanned bulletin; OCR/scanning artifacts are preserved.
